AboutPage.title: Who We Are
AboutPage.description: A network of young people under 30 working together to address local, regional, and global challenges, born out of the World Economic Forum and rooted in Jeddah.
AboutPage.shapersSubtitle: Driven leaders from diverse backgrounds: entrepreneurs, doctors, engineers, artists, and more.
AboutPage.alumniSubtitle: Past shapers who continue to inspire and make a difference.
AboutPage.noShapers: Shapers are setting up their profiles. Check back soon.
AboutPage.wefDesc: The Global Shapers Community is a World Economic Forum initiative connecting young people whose ideas and actions drive positive change. With 500+ hubs worldwide, we are part of a vibrant global movement.
AboutPage.ctaDesc: Join a community of driven young leaders shaping the future of Jeddah.
AboutPage.missionGlobalBody: We start with the people closest to a problem, listening first, then building projects shaped by the community's own priorities, not assumptions made from the outside.
AboutPage.missionLocalBody: We partner across government, business, and civil society, because durable change comes from shared ownership, not any one group acting alone.
AboutPage.missionYouthBody: We measure success in the years after a project launches, not just its opening day. Initiatives are designed to outlast any single Shaper's involvement.
AboutPage.missionDialogueBody: Whether you lead an initiative, join one, or simply show up, every level of involvement moves the Hub's work forward.

BecomeShaperPage.title: Become a Shaper
BecomeShaperPage.subtitle: Join a new generation of young leaders, from 18 to 27, shaping the future of Jeddah, one initiative at a time.
BecomeShaperPage.whoBody: Global Shapers are driven young people between the ages of 18 and 27 who are committed to creating positive change in their cities. Our members come from all walks of life: engineers, educators, entrepreneurs, and creatives, united by a shared passion for meaningful impact. Membership is entirely voluntary and requires roughly 10 hours of engagement per week.
BecomeShaperPage.ctaBody: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Take the first step today.
BecomeShaperPage.ctaNote: You will be redirected to the official World Economic Forum application portal.
criteria1: Based in or connected to Jeddah
Strong communication skills in English or Arabic
criteria2: Clear alignment with the hub's mission and values
A proactive mindset with the drive to take ownership
Collaborative spirit and commitment to the team
A demonstrated history of impact, big or small
criteria3: Participate in regular hub meetings and community events
Actively contribute to at least one project or initiative
Represent the hub in local and international dialogues
Expand your skills through real-world collaboration

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Submit your application with your background, interests, and motivation to join. Applications open in one or two cycles per year, aligned with the hub's annual vision.

steps.title: Screening
steps.body: Our team reviews applications within the cycle window. We may reach out with follow-up questions or additional steps.

steps.title: Interview
steps.body: Shortlisted candidates are invited for a conversation with hub members to explore alignment and fit.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: Successful applicants join as Guest Shapers: a structured probation period. After completing the evaluation, they advance to full Shaper membership with all its rights and responsibilities.

BecomeShaperPage.drivenSubtitle: Driven young people creating positive change.
BecomeShaperPage.valuesSubtitle: What joining the hub really means
BecomeShaperPage.value1Body: Regular in-person meetings, workshops, and social events to connect, ideate, and grow together.
BecomeShaperPage.value2Body: Access to the WEF Global Shapers network, with 10,000+ members across 500+ cities worldwide.
BecomeShaperPage.value3Body: Lead or contribute to active initiatives that create measurable impact in Jeddah.
BecomeShaperPage.value4Body: Hands-on experience in project management, advocacy, communications, and leadership.
BecomeShaperPage.voicesSubtitle: What members say about the experience
BecomeShaperPage.quote1: Joining Jeddah Hub connected me to people who share my belief that young people can lead real change. The projects we work on aren't just ideas. They're real.
BecomeShaperPage.quote2: I came in wanting to do something meaningful. I stayed because of the community. Being a Shaper has pushed me to think bigger and act bolder.
BecomeShaperPage.faq1Q: Is there a membership fee to join?
BecomeShaperPage.faq1A: No. Membership is entirely voluntary and free. The only expectation is your time and genuine commitment, roughly 10 hours a week, to the hub and its initiatives.
BecomeShaperPage.faq2Q: Do I need to already live in Jeddah to apply?
BecomeShaperPage.faq2A: You should be based in or closely connected to Jeddah, since most gatherings, workshops, and initiatives happen in person here. If you're relocating to the city soon, mention that in your application.
BecomeShaperPage.faq3Q: What is the expected time commitment?
BecomeShaperPage.faq3A: Around 10 hours a week on average, split between hub meetings, community events, and active work on at least one project or initiative. It varies by season and by what you choose to lead.
BecomeShaperPage.faq4Q: How long does the application process take?
BecomeShaperPage.faq4A: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis within each cycle. After screening, shortlisted candidates are invited to an interview, and successful applicants join as Guest Shapers for a probation period before full membership.
BecomeShaperPage.faq5Q: I don't have leadership experience. Can I still apply?
BecomeShaperPage.faq5A: Yes. We look for genuine passion, a proactive mindset, and a willingness to contribute, not a resume. Many of our most active Shapers started with no prior leadership experience and grew into it here.

PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.subtitle: How Jeddah Hub collects, uses, and protects your information.
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro: Jeddah Hub (Global Shapers Community, Jeddah Hub) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through jeddahhub.org, why we collect it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body:
Newsletter: when you subscribe, we store your email address and the date you subscribed.

Contact form: when you send us a message, we store your name, email address, subject, and message content so we can reply to you.

Hub Activity and workshop registrations: when you register for a Hub Activity or workshop, we store your answers to the registration form, along with your name and email address if you choose to provide them, so organizers can plan the event and follow up with you.

Initiative and impact content: initiative pages, impact reports, and blog posts published through the site may include names, photos, and project details submitted by Shapers and curators.

Automatically collected data: we use small amounts of local browser storage to remember your language and theme preference, to show the welcome screen only once per visit, and to let you like a blog post using an anonymous, randomly generated identifier that is not linked to your real identity.

sections.heading: Become a Shaper Applications
sections.body: Applying to become a Global Shaper is handled entirely by the World Economic Forum on its own application platform, external to jeddahhub.org. When you click "Apply Now," you leave our site. We do not receive, store, or process the information you submit on that form. It is governed by the World Economic Forum's own privacy practices, not this policy.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body:
We use the information above to send the newsletter you subscribed to, respond to messages sent through the contact form, organize Hub Activities and workshops you register for, and maintain the security and basic functioning of the site.

We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies
sections.body: We use functional local storage rather than tracking cookies: your saved language and theme preference, a flag so the welcome animation shows once per visit, and an anonymous identifier if you like a blog post. None of this is used to track you across other websites.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: We rely on a small number of service providers to operate the site: Google Firebase for our database and infrastructure; Google reCAPTCHA to protect our contact form from automated abuse; and a transactional email provider to deliver the newsletter welcome email. Each of these providers processes data on our behalf and maintains its own privacy and security practices.

sections.heading: Data Sharing and Disclosure
sections.body: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We share it only with the service providers described above, to the extent needed to operate the site, and if required to comply with a legal obligation or to protect the rights, safety, or property of Jeddah Hub or others.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We keep newsletter, contact form, and activity registration data for as long as needed to serve their purpose, or until you ask us to remove it.

sections.heading: Your Choices and Rights
sections.body: To unsubscribe from the newsletter or request that we delete personal information we hold about you, contact us using the details below and we will act on your request promptly.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: Jeddah Hub is a Global Shapers Community hub for young people generally between 18 and 27 years old. Our site is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We use industry-standard measures, including encrypted connections and access controls provided by our infrastructure providers, to protect the information we hold. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your information appropriately.

sections.heading: International Data Transfers
sections.body: Jeddah Hub is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Because we use global infrastructure providers, your information may be processed in other countries. We take steps to ensure it continues to receive an appropriate level of protection wherever it is processed.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: The Jeddah Hub name, logo, and the design, graphics, and text of this site belong to Jeddah Hub or its licensors, except for content submitted by Shapers and curators (such as blog posts, initiative pages, and impact reports) and third-party marks such as the Global Shapers Community and World Economic Forum names. This policy governs how we handle personal information; it does not grant any rights to reuse or copy the site's content, which are addressed in our Terms of Use.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes to the site or our practices. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised. Continued use of the site after an update means you accept the revised policy.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or how your information is handled, reach us at jeddahglobalshapers@gmail.com or through our Contact page.

TermsOfUsePage.title: Terms of Use
TermsOfUsePage.subtitle: The rules for using the Jeddah Hub website.
TermsOfUsePage.intro: These terms govern your use of jeddahhub.org, operated by Jeddah Hub, a Global Shapers Community hub and an initiative of the World Economic Forum. By using this site, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: Eligibility to Become a Shaper
sections.body: Membership as a Global Shaper is a separate process, administered by the World Economic Forum through its own application platform, and is generally open to driven young people between 18 and 27 years old. Applying does not guarantee acceptance, and eligibility criteria are set by the World Economic Forum, not by these terms.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the site, including attempting to access data that is not yours, disrupting the site's normal operation, submitting false or misleading information through a Hub Activity or workshop registration form, or using automated tools to scrape or overload it.

sections.heading: Third-Party Links
sections.body: This site links to third-party destinations we do not control, including the World Economic Forum's Global Shapers application form and our social media profiles. We are not responsible for the content, terms, or privacy practices of those external sites.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: The Jeddah Hub name, logo, and the design, graphics, and text of this site belong to Jeddah Hub or its licensors and may not be copied or used without permission, with two exceptions: third-party marks such as the Global Shapers Community and World Economic Forum names, and content you submit yourself.

sections.heading: Disclaimers
sections.body: This site and its content are provided "as is," without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee the site will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that impact figures and other statistics will be precisely up to date at every moment.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Jeddah Hub is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of this site.

sections.heading: Enforcement
sections.body: We may restrict or remove access to this site for anyone who violates these terms, without notice, at our discretion.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when they were last revised. Continued use of the site after an update means you accept the revised terms.

sections.heading: Contact Us
